summary: UI-only verification of MyCoaching.jsx calendar redesign (rows as bigger clickable buttons w/ emerald 'Done' state). Logged in as storefront1786720928@example.com via /api/auth/login + localStorage.ghp_token injection (login form workaround from iteration 7). /account rendered MyCoaching section with 72 calendar entries, each exposing data-testid=cal-entry-{id}. Verified: (1) clicking a NOT-DONE row fires PATCH /api/coaching/my/calendar/{id}?done=true, transitions row to bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200, checkbox square becomes bg-emerald-500 border-emerald-500 with white check, small 'Done' pill appears, NO line-through class. (2) Clicking the DONE row fires PATCH ?done=false and reverts to bg-white border-slate-200 with empty square. (3) Re-toggled ON and page reload — row remained emerald (server-persisted). (4) Regression: 2 per-item add-to-cart buttons + 1 add-all-to-cart button + message input + protocol header + compliance banner all rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: MyCoaching.jsx toggle() silently swallows errors in catch block — a failing PATCH will leave optimistic UI unchanged but user sees success visual. Consider toast.error on failure and reverting local state.
